items.description: Fifty cents of pure proof. A full-screen animated sparkle shower for your house — and it proves the whole Bling loop works end to end.
items.name: Spark test

items.description: Neon icons for the nine rooms. Once this is owned, each room's icon is its neon image (travel, health, home, money, game, art, dev, coach, bling).
items.name: Neon Nights

items.description: The Bling room speaks as a midnight diner for 30 days from the purchase time, then it reverts. The end time is the purchase timestamp plus 30 days.
items.name: Midnight Diner

items.description: Returns a year count on the room brief: how many rooms, and the board-card types named in those blueprints. It is not posted to chat and it does not read a live house board.
items.name: Year in Review

items.description: Six briefing voices already in the pack: Drill Sergeant, Bedtime Story, Newscaster, Poet, Cornerman, Deadpan. Owning it sets the morning-briefing prompt to one of those instructions (Newscaster unless you pick another). This service does not edit a cron on your host.
items.name: Voice Pack

items.description: Puts one existing sticker GIF on the shop page after purchase, and on the order as the image to show in the Bling room.
items.name: Mystery Drop

items.description: Swaps room icons for the current quarter's image from this pack: moon, leaf, candy, or ghost. The image changes with the calendar quarter. Seasonal wins over Neon Nights while both are owned.
items.name: Seasonal Pack
House anthem
items.description: Thirty seconds of house pride on a shared anthem track. Optional: add ?house=YourName to show the name on the page (display only — same audio for every house).

items.name: House Stickers Vol. 1
items.description: Six animated stickers for your house — sparkle bursts, a spinning gem, a little rocket. Stick them anywhere.
